input.question: Why do we forget our dreams after waking up?
input.ground_truth: They aren't important to you. If you write them down or even mentally reevaluate them before you get out of bed or reorient yourself, you'll retain them better, but on a base level your brain prioritizes remembering real sense-data and clearing out or ignoring your "imagination."

Question: Why do we forget our dreams after waking up?

Answer:

response.prediction: Okay! Imagine your brain is like a little box where you put toys (which are your dreams). When you go to sleep, your brain plays with those toys and makes up fun stories (those are your dreams). But when you wake up, your brain says, "Time to put the toys away and get ready for the day!" So, it closes the box and sometimes you can't remember what toys were inside. That's why you forget your dreams when you wake up!
